observations.text: When RUV-36 is activated, it changes NAK-47 into an active carrier.
An active NAK-47 causes JOR-58 to be emitted.
Whenever JOR-58 reaches VEL-69, that VEL-69 adopts the terminal marker SAD-80.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of JOR-58 through VEL-69 is SAD-80; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims VEL-69 instead carries terminal marker BAD-97.
